title: Bear Den TV state snapshot (protocol 1)
description: Pushed by the coordinator to authenticated phones (redacted per permission) and to the TV shell (full). Absent optional objects mean 'not visible to this viewer', never 'unknown'.

generated_at_ms.description: Coordinator monotonic milliseconds; ordering only, not wall-clock.

dev_mode.description: True only when the coordinator was started with --dev-fixtures; every fixture item is labeled DEMO.

desktop_adapter.description: Backend name such as x11-ewmh-xtest, wayland-limited, fake.

observed.description: True when the foreground was verified by the desktop adapter, false when inferred from intent only.

window_title.description: Never contains private media titles for external apps; coordinator redacts to the app label.

capabilities.description: Per action for the current target: available with backend, or unavailable with a reason.

hidden.description: true when the app is optional (config hide_when_missing) and its Flatpak is not installed (or not yet discovered): the shell and phones show no tile for it. Absent means false. Also true for an app the owner turned off (enabled false).

enabled.description: Present only for apps the owner can turn on and off on the TV (web adapters: Settings -> Streaming sites, IPC app.enable); false means turned off, and then hidden is true. Absent for every other app.

notes.description: What the owner should know about this app, as short plain sentences (caveats, what it needs, what the remote reaches), for the shell and every phone. The adapter table's notes (internal/applications/adapters, Notes) plus notes the coordinator derives from live data, such as an unverified streaming browser. Absent when there are none; older coordinators never send it.

addresses.description: Literal URLs the coordinator is bound to; empty when not listening.

now_playing.description: The owner's config remote.now_playing (default true): paired phones may see state.now_playing. Not sensitive; the TV Settings row reads it.

me.description: The viewing device's own session (phones only).

permissions.description: guest is a time-limited guest pass and never comes with another permission.

expires_at_ms.description: Guest passes only: when the pass ends, Unix epoch milliseconds on the coordinator's wall clock. Required with guest, absent otherwise.

appearance.description: The TV's look, mirrored by paired phones: the themed world, the style and the accent (not sensitive).

pixel.description: The backdrop in use is pixel art: draw it without smoothing.

art_style.description: The TV's art style (layout.ui.art_style): pixel art, or smooth classic art. Missing means pixel.

app_icons.description: The TV's app icon choice (layout.ui.app_icons): app (the app's own icon, served by GET /api/v1/apps/{adapter}/icon) or bear_den. Missing means app.

focus.description: The phone's tile decoration: the theme's focus style and ornament URLs (same origin).

pairing.description: Shell only. The live invitation the TV is displaying, or null.

url.description: Full QR URL including the single-use fragment token; only ever sent over the private IPC socket.

qr_modules.description: Rows of 0/1 characters; rendered by the shell.

guest.description: The live invitation is a guest pass (pair.issue with pass); missing means false.

pass_expires_at_ms.description: Guest pass only: when the pass will end, Unix epoch milliseconds (wall clock); null or absent otherwise.

guest.description: A guest pass (permissions is ["guest"]); missing means false.

expires_at_ms.description: Guest passes: when the pass ends and the device is revoked, Unix epoch milliseconds (wall clock); null or absent for family phones.

layout.description: Portable layout/appearance subset of the configuration (editor permission or shell).

layout_pending.description: A timed layout change awaiting confirmation; null when none.

playback.description: Latest playback detection test (shell view only): the box, the display, and per app hardware decoding, expectations, caveats and tuning status (internal/applications/tuning).

settings.description: Settings the owner may adjust by hand (TV Settings → Advanced playback), with only the options this box can handle. value is the one in effect: the override while it is offered, else auto.

weather.description: Shell view only: local weather for the header chip and the scene. Phones and anonymous viewers never get it; a locked session omits it.

plex.description: Shell view only, omitted while locked; never sent to phones. The Plex sign-in flow for TV Settings → Plex (contracts/ipc.md plex.*). Absent when the session has no Plex connector. The link code is shown on the TV only; the account token never appears here.

message.description: User-facing text; empty when nothing needs saying.

code.description: The link code to type at link_url while status is linking; otherwise null.

link_url.description: Where to type the code (https://plex.tv/link) while status is linking; otherwise null. Shown and drawn as a QR code by the shell; the coordinator never fetches it.

qr_modules.description: link_url as a QR code while status is linking (rows of 0/1 characters, rendered by the shell like pairing.qr_modules); otherwise absent or null.

server.description: The chosen server's name, when known.

servers.description: The account's servers while status is choose_server; otherwise empty.

local.description: Plex offers a connection on the home network.

libraries.description: The chosen server's libraries while status is choose_libraries (selected: the proposed choice) or connected (selected: what rows use); otherwise empty.

now_playing.description: Phones with the controller permission or a guest pass only: what an app's own MPRIS player reports while that app is in front or, with foreground false, while it plays or is paused behind Home. Omitted for the shell, anonymous viewers and phones with neither, while the session is locked, when config remote.now_playing is false, and when nothing is known; null means the same as absent. Never logged, persisted or included in diagnostics (docs/security.md).

app_id.description: The application (state.applications[].id) whose player this is: the app in front, or with foreground false the app behind Home.

foreground.description: true (absent from older coordinators means the same): app_id is in front. false: Bear Den's shell is in front and app_id plays or is paused behind Home (status is then never stopped); media.play, media.pause and media.seek_relative for it name app_id as their target, never "active".

source.description: Where the reading comes from (absent from older coordinators means mpris): the app's own MPRIS player, or, for Plex HTPC (which has none), what the owner's Plex server lists for this TV's Plex HTPC (GET /status/sessions). plex_server readings are read-only: media actions are never offered for them.

title.description: xesam:title (or the Plex item's title), cut to 200 characters. Private media: shown to phones only.

subtitle.description: xesam:artist joined with ', ', else xesam:album; absent when the player reports neither.

length_ms.description: mpris:length; absent when unknown (live streams, players that omit it).

position_ms.description: Position when it was read; absent when the player does not report one.

position_at.description: When the player was read, in the same coordinator monotonic milliseconds as generated_at_ms. Phones extrapolate while status is playing: position_ms + rate x (generated_at_ms - position_at + time since the snapshot arrived).

rate.description: Playback rate (MPRIS Rate; 1 when the player does not report it).

achievements.description: Den badges (docs/security.md#den-badges): local counters turned into playful badges. Shell view, and phones with the controller permission; never guests, anonymous viewers or a locked session. Only badge ids, counts and the local day a badge was earned: never titles, apps' media, times of day or anything else about what was watched.

enabled.description: config achievements.enabled (default true). False: nothing is counted; badges already earned stay until reset.

day.description: The local calendar day it was earned (YYYY-MM-DD); never a time.

progress.description: Every badge in the catalogue, in display order: how far along it is. count never exceeds goal.

celebrate.description: Shell view only: badges earned but not yet celebrated on Home (IPC achievements.celebrated clears them). Phones never get it.

power.description: The sleep timer and the display (contracts/actions.md power.sleep_timer, display.off; http.md "Sleep timer and screen off"). Not private: sent to the shell and to every authenticated phone, also while locked (the shell needs display to swallow the key that wakes it); never to anonymous viewers. Absent from older coordinators.

sleep_at_ms.description: When the sleep timer fires, in the coordinator monotonic milliseconds of generated_at_ms (not wall-clock); null when no timer is set. Phones count down sleep_at_ms - generated_at_ms - time since the snapshot arrived.

sleep_minutes.description: The choice that set the running timer; absent when none is set.

warning.description: True during the last 60 s before the timer fires: the TV shows 'Going to sleep in 1 minute' and any input cancels the timer.

display.description: off while Bear Den has turned the display off (display.off or the timer); any input turns it on again.

suspend.description: Whether the box could be suspended. Bear Den never suspends today; reason says why (for example the system asks for a password).

apps.description: App installs from Flathub (contracts/http.md "App installs"; config apps). Shell and owner phones only; absent from older coordinators.

auto_update.description: config apps.auto_update (absent = true): Bear Den updates the apps it installed for this user while the TV is idle.

browser.description: config apps.browser: the Browser tile's browser, a browsers[].id. Absent from older coordinators.

streaming_browser.description: config apps.streaming_browser: the streaming sites' browser, a browsers[].id. Absent from older coordinators.

browsers.description: The browsers web apps may run in (the adapter table's, in the order the TV offers them). Absent from older coordinators.

streaming_unverified.description: true: nothing shows the streaming sites' Widevine works in this browser's Flatpak; the TV says "unverified for streaming" beside it.

notes.description: Plain words the TV shows beside the choice (who makes it, what it shares, its limits). Optional; absent from older coordinators.

onboarding.description: Shell view only; never sent to phones. Absent from older coordinators (the shell then treats setup as done). Mirrors config onboarding.completed: false until the owner finishes the TV's first-run setup (IPC onboarding.complete) or turns the phone remote on (IPC remote.configure with enabled true).

autostart.description: Shell view only; never sent to phones. Absent from older coordinators. Whether Bear Den starts with this PC: the user's XDG autostart entry, the same one `bear-den-tv autostart enable` writes (IPC autostart.configure turns it on or off).

enabled.description: The user's autostart entry (bear-den-tv.desktop in the XDG autostart folder) exists.

available.description: The TV can turn it on: this session supports it and Bear Den's start script was found.

reason.description: Why it is not available, in plain words for the TV; present only when available is false. Never a path.

cec.description: TV control over HDMI-CEC (contracts/http.md "TV control over HDMI-CEC"; config cec). Sent to the shell and to every authenticated phone, also while locked; never to anonymous viewers. Absent from older coordinators.

available.description: An HDMI-CEC adapter (/dev/cecN) was found and opened.

reason.description: Why it is not available, for the TV Settings row; present only when available is false.

enabled.description: The owner's config cec.enabled (default false). Bear Den sends nothing on the HDMI-CEC bus while false.

volume_target.description: Config cec.volume_target (default pc): which volume audio.volume_delta and audio.mute change while CEC is enabled. pc while CEC is off.

tv_power.description: The TV's answer to Give Device Power Status (in transition counts as the state it is heading to); unknown when CEC is off, unavailable or the TV did not answer.

content.description: Optional provider rows (Plex connector). Absent when no provider is configured.

artwork.description: Coordinator-local artwork path or proxied URL; never a credentialed upstream URL.

allOf.description: A guest pass never sees badges.
celebrate is for the shell only.
Only owner phones (and the shell) see installs: a phone without owner, a guest pass included, gets no applications[].install and no apps.
Setup and autostart are for the shell only: a phone view (with me) carries neither onboarding nor autostart.

install.description: The app's Flatpak install from Flathub, per user (contracts/http.md "App installs"). Apps that share a Flatpak (the streaming sites all use Google Chrome by default) share one install. Shell and owner phones only.

state.description: none: nothing to install (installed, or installs are unavailable: message says why); available: not installed and Install would work; preparing: adding Flathub, reading sizes, checking free space; downloading: flatpak is fetching and deploying (phase says what); installing: flatpak finished, Bear Den is checking the result; failed: message says why; done: installed by this session.

phase.description: What is happening now: checking (sizes and free space), runtime (a shared runtime or extension), app (the app itself), finishing (checking the result); empty when idle.

size_bytes.description: About how much to download: the app and any runtime it needs that is not installed yet, from Flathub's metadata. Absent until known.

disk_bytes.description: About how much disk the app and missing runtime take once installed. Absent until known.

message.description: Plain words for the owner: why it failed, why installs are unavailable, or "Updated by your system" for a system-wide install.

drm.description: Streaming web apps only, once their browser is installed: ready when the browser can play protected video for the app (Google Chrome: the Widevine CDM bundled in the installed Flatpak; Brave: the app's profile has WidevineCdm/*/manifest.json), preparing while Bear Den's first quiet run fetches it, pending when it is not there yet ("Still setting up playback support").

badgeId.description: A badge id from the catalogue in internal/achievements (for example first-night-in).
